_comment: One source of truth for week 6's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. If a number changes it changes HERE first. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b); the coursework repo is cloned only for the hygiene sweep, which covers both and scores once.

Check1_YourRecordKeepsThePromise.label: IListed exists, and your record keeps it — a Kind of its own and a Line() that names the record it is about

Check2_EachRecordWritesItsOwnLine.label: Two different records write two different lines, and both call themselves the same Kind

Check3_TheRegistryKeepsItToo.label: Registry keeps IListed as well — a different Kind, a different Line(), and it is not a kind of record

Check4_OneListHoldsThemBoth.label: Registry.Everything() hands back one List<IListed> holding the registry's own line and every record it is actually holding

Check5_WeeksFourAndFiveStillHold.label: Weeks 4 and 5 still hold — no public fields, All() still copies, Find and Remove still behave, Topic still says something

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programRuns.label: The program builds and runs without crashing — even when fed nothing but Enter

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked in NEITHER repo — the .gitignore holding, in both places

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgement call)

mergedPr.label: A merge commit on main — this week's branch → pull request → merge
